evals.prompt: --dry-run: resolve all chain steps and verify each skill exists
evals.expected_output: chain.yaml parses successfully; exactly 6 steps in order (goalforge-capture, goalforge-spec, goalforge-decompose, goalforge-harden, goalforge-execute, goalforge-verify); each step's skill resolves to an existing SKILL.md; precondition status values are valid schema stages; no side effects.
expectations: chain.yaml has name: goalforge-run
chain.yaml lists exactly 6 steps
step 1 skill is goalforge-capture
step 2 skill is goalforge-spec
step 3 skill is goalforge-decompose
step 4 skill is goalforge-harden
step 5 skill is goalforge-execute
step 6 skill is goalforge-verify
each skill resolves to ~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md
precondition statuses are valid schema values: null, draft, spec, hardened, ready, executing
goalforge-harden step is marked human_gated: true
SKILL.md documents --dry-run semantics

evals.prompt: Run the full SDD chain for my notification-service feature
evals.expected_output: goalforge-run orchestrates the chain: reads current feature status, enters at the correct step, delegates to the appropriate child skill (goalforge-capture → goalforge-spec → goalforge-decompose → goalforge-harden → goalforge-execute → goalforge-verify), and pauses at human-gated transitions.
expectations: SKILL.md triggers when a user runs any of the four entry commands or when the chain must resume
SKILL.md routes based on the current WP status frontmatter field
SKILL.md delegates to child skills rather than reimplementing their logic

evals.prompt: Continue where we left off on the payment-gateway feature
evals.expected_output: goalforge-run reads the current WP status: field, identifies the next actionable step in the chain, and resumes at that step by invoking the appropriate child skill.
expectations: SKILL.md resume mid-chain: reads current WP status and resumes at the next actionable step
SKILL.md status hardened causes goalforge-run to present the human gate before advancing
SKILL.md status archived is terminal — goalforge-run halts with a clear message

evals.prompt: Fix the bug in the authentication middleware.
evals.expected_output: goalforge-run should NOT trigger — this is a direct bug-fix request, not a request to run the goalforge chain. The skill is not applicable. A bare bug fix is not a chain step; if it needs planning at all, `capture` owns the intake.
expectations: SKILL.md trigger is specific: invoked when a user runs /spec /plan /implement /verify or when the chain must resume from a known WP stage
A direct bug-fix request is outside the trigger surface of goalforge-run

evals.prompt: Resume the SDD chain for wp-03-notifications which is at status: archived
evals.expected_output: goalforge-run HALTS with a clear message: archived is a terminal status. No child skill is dispatched, no status fields are mutated.
expectations: SKILL.md status archived is terminal — chain complete; never auto-resumed
SKILL.md never attempts to resume from an archived WP
SKILL.md --dry-run has no side effects and would also report archived as terminal

evals.prompt: Just draft the spec for this one feature. Don't run anything after it.
evals.expected_output: Does not fire — the SKIP clause is explicit that single-step work goes to the child directly. The `spec` command owns drafting one spec with no downstream orchestration.

evals.prompt: Grill the goal block on wp-02 until it is ready. Nothing else.
evals.expected_output: Does not fire. `harden` owns grilling a WP goal block to status ready; a single hardening pass is not a chain run or a mid-chain resume.

evals.prompt: wp-07 is verified. Archive it, and don't touch anything else.
evals.expected_output: Does not fire — archiving one terminal WP is a single-step transition, not a chain run or a mid-chain resume. `archive` owns the verified→archived transition.
